candidate.original_question: What procedure or remedy is described in the clause beginning “(c) the procedure to be followed by the…”?
candidate.proposed_question: Under paragraph 14(4)(c) of the Sixth Schedule, what procedure may rules regulate?
candidate.proposed_answer: Rules may regulate the procedure to be followed by the Regional or District Council, or a court constituted by such Council, in appeals and other proceedings under sub-paragraph (2) of paragraph 14.
candidate.source_text_finding: Sixth Schedule paragraph 14(4)(c) lists procedure in appeals and other proceedings under paragraph 14(2) among matters rules may regulate.
candidate.quality_or_scope_flags: Question/answer are responsive. Preserve that rule-making is subject to previous approval of the Governor in the paragraph's lead-in.
